jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Vireo Environmental runs continuous air and water monitoring networks for utilities and municipal authorities, and the readings that come back are noisy. You will join a four-person research group as its junior modelling engineer, helping separate genuine pollution events from instrument drift so field crews are dispatched for the right reasons.

Responsibilities
• Train and evaluate detection models against multi-year sensor archives
• Group station readings into cohorts that expose failing hardware early
• Produce charts and short written findings for scientists who do not code
• Package each experiment so a colleague can rerun it from a clean checkout
• Sit with field technicians each quarter to keep assumptions grounded

Requirements
• Doctoral research in an environmental, physical or computational discipline
• Demonstrated modelling work on real, messy measurement data
• Fluency with the scientific Python stack for analysis and plotting
• Ability to explain statistical uncertainty to a non-technical regulator
• Habit of recording method and assumptions as the work happens

Nice to have
• Exposure to language models for summarising inspection notes
• Familiarity with seasonal decomposition of long measurement series
• Prior work inside an accredited testing laboratory

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Palewood Furniture sells through 40 showrooms and a growing online storefront, and the order system behind both has been running since 2004. This is a graduate opening on the platform team, which is steadily carving that system into services without ever stopping the tills.

Responsibilities
• Ship small, reviewed changes to order and stock services weekly
• Read and safely amend legacy batch routines that still settle daily takings
• Write tests around behaviour before refactoring the code beneath it
• Containerise services so local setup no longer takes a full morning
• Record what you changed in the team log for showroom support staff

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in computing or a numerate subject
• Coursework or placement experience writing tested, reviewed code
• Working knowledge of relational data and why query plans matter
• Willingness to learn an older language rather than route around it
• Clear written updates, since half the team works from Krakow

Nice to have
• Any exposure to a build pipeline you did not set up yourself
• Curiosity about retail stock accuracy and the cost of getting it wrong

jobs.title: Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Redstone Mining moves ore data between weighbridges, fleet telemetry and a corporate finance system that expects clean daily totals. You will be the junior engineer on a two-person integration team, keeping those handoffs honest across three sites in the Midlands and one in Chile.

Responsibilities
• Build and monitor scheduled feeds between site systems and head office
• Reconcile daily tonnage figures and chase the source of every mismatch
• Expose site data through a small internal web view for planners
• Document each interface so a night-shift engineer can restart it alone
• Escalate data-quality problems to the originating site rather than patching

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in engineering, computing or information systems
• One to two years building or supporting data interfaces
• Comfort reading structured payloads and spotting a schema change fast
• Patience for working with colleagues across languages and time zones
• Willingness to be on site, in boots, when a feed breaks at the pit

Nice to have
• Experience with a cloud warehouse used for reporting
• Interest in continuing study toward chartered engineer status

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Clearpoint Diagnostics builds the ordering and results portal that clinicians use between patient appointments. Screens are read under time pressure by people who cannot afford to misread a number, so the frontend team treats clarity and correctness as clinical requirements rather than polish.

Responsibilities
• Build results and ordering screens against a documented design system
• Write browser tests that cover the paths a clinician actually takes
• Fix rendering defects reported by hospital support within the same sprint
• Pair with a senior engineer on anything touching patient identifiers
• Keep bundle size in budget so the portal opens on ward hardware

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree and one to three years of professional frontend work
• Solid grasp of semantic markup and how assistive technology reads it
• Experience writing automated browser tests, not only unit tests
• Care with data shapes coming back from an unfamiliar backend
• Ability to take review feedback without taking it personally

Nice to have
• Any healthcare, laboratory or regulated-software background
• Familiarity with analytics tooling for measuring portal usage
• Interest in mentoring interns as the team grows

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Ardent Logistics moves freight across 14 European hubs, and every hub depends on the same identity and access layer. This six-month internship places you inside the platform group in Zurich, working on the plumbing that decides who may see which shipment.

Responsibilities
• Assist with access reviews across warehouse and driver applications
• Script repeatable environment builds instead of clicking through consoles
• Test firewall and gateway rules in a sandbox before change windows
• Write runbooks for the tasks you automate, in English and German
• Present your project to the platform group at the end of the placement

Requirements
• Enrolled in or recently finished a Bachelor's in computing or security
• Foundational understanding of authentication and authorisation flows
• Some scripting experience, from coursework or personal projects
• Careful, methodical approach to anything that touches production access
• Right to work in Switzerland for the internship period

Nice to have
• Exposure to a version control platform beyond a single class project
• Interest in the safety culture that surrounds logistics infrastructure

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
About the role
Ashford & Pike advises insurers and property funds, and its analytics practice is now expected to produce evidence rather than opinion. You will be the junior data scientist supporting two partners, turning claims photographs and inspection reports into figures a client will act on.

Responsibilities
• Explore new client datasets and report what is usable before work is scoped
• Build image-based damage classifiers from labelled inspection archives
• Design features with the domain expert rather than in isolation
• Publish dashboards partners can take directly into a client meeting
• Run internal teaching sessions on the methods you have adopted

Requirements
• Doctoral training with a strong applied or statistical component
• Experience taking a model from notebook to something colleagues can use
• Ability to defend a method under sharp questioning from a partner
• Confidence presenting to audiences with no technical background
• Discretion with commercially sensitive client material

Nice to have
• Familiarity with retrieval over unstructured document collections
• Exposure to deployment practice for models in production
• Consulting or professional services experience

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Cobalt Health Services runs booking, triage and records platforms for a network of private clinics. Uptime is a patient-safety matter, so the platform team is measured on how quickly incidents are detected and how rarely patients notice. This is an early-career post with a named mentor.

Responsibilities
• Extend dashboards and alerts so on-call engineers wake for real problems
• Tune traffic distribution across clinic-facing services during peak hours
• Automate the toil items your team logs during each incident review
• Take part in daytime on-call once you complete the shadowing period
• Write clear incident timelines after every clinic-visible disruption

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience
• Comfort at a Linux command line without reaching for a search engine first
• Some exposure to a major cloud provider from study or a placement
• Composure when a system is degraded and people are asking for updates
• Willingness to adapt as the team's practices change month to month

Nice to have
• Any experience with a continuous integration service
• Interest in reliability engineering as a long-term specialism

jobs.title: Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Sandpiper Apparel releases two collections a year, and each release touches the storefront, the warehouse app and the loyalty programme. The quality team in Toronto keeps that release train honest. You join it as a junior automation engineer with a clear brief: shrink the manual regression pack.

Responsibilities
• Convert manual regression scripts into maintainable automated suites
• Investigate failing runs and separate real defects from flaky selectors
• Test checkout journeys across the payment methods each market uses
• Report coverage gaps to product owners in language they can act on
• Keep the test data set realistic as the catalogue changes each season

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree and one to three years in a testing role
• Hands-on experience with at least one browser automation framework
• Ability to write a defect report a developer can reproduce first time
• Stubbornness about intermittent failures rather than tolerance for them
• Comfort working on site with merchandising and warehouse colleagues

Nice to have
• Retail or e-commerce testing experience
• An eye for visual detail on brand-critical pages

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Silverbrook Chemicals manufactures speciality coatings, and its plants are increasingly networked. The security team is small, remote-first and focused on the boundary between corporate IT and plant systems. You will start on the monitoring side, where the alerts are and where the learning is fastest.

Responsibilities
• Triage security alerts and hand off confirmed findings with full context
• Harden build agents and container images used across engineering
• Add security gates to delivery pipelines without stalling releases
• Track vulnerability remediation with the teams that own the systems
• Join the fortnightly review where recent incidents are dissected

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in computing, security or a related discipline
• One to two years in a technical role with genuine security exposure
• Understanding of how build and deploy pipelines can be abused
• Ability to explain risk to a plant manager in plant-manager terms
• Curiosity that survives a week of false positives

Nice to have
• Reading habit around published research and advisories
• Familiarity with certificate handling and transport security

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Ardent Logistics is rebuilding how shipment events reach its analytics estate, and the internship sits inside that programme. Over six months you will work alongside two data engineers on the pipelines that carry tracking events from carrier feeds into the warehouse.

Responsibilities
• Build and test ingestion jobs for carrier event feeds under supervision
• Investigate gaps between carrier records and internal shipment history
• Improve search indexing so operations staff find consignments quickly
• Document each pipeline you touch, including its failure modes
• Share progress in weekly demos to the wider data group

Requirements
• Studying toward a Bachelor's in computing, data or a numerate subject
• Some experience moving and reshaping data outside a spreadsheet
• Understanding of why replicated systems disagree with each other
• Willingness to ask early rather than lose a day to a wrong assumption
• Right to work in Switzerland for the internship period

Nice to have
• Coursework in modelling or applied machine learning
• Interest in how freight networks behave under disruption

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Granite Peak Energy operates onshore wind assets and sells the output through a trading desk in Hamburg. Its internal tooling spans turbine telemetry, maintenance scheduling and settlement. You join as a graduate engineer on a team that builds across all three.

Responsibilities
• Build service endpoints and the screens that consume them
• Model new domain concepts with the engineer who owns that area
• Break a monolithic settlement routine into testable components
• Report progress honestly in stand-up, including what is stuck
• Support your changes through their first month in production

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in computing, engineering or physics
• Up to three years writing production code in a typed language
• Understanding of how relational schemas are designed and why
• Appetite for the domain, not only for the technology
• German or willingness to learn it, as the trading desk works in German

Nice to have
• Exposure to data lake or warehouse tooling
• Interest in the energy transition beyond the job description
• Experience with automated testing in a professional setting

jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Northwind Systems ships an enterprise scheduling suite with a long-lived desktop client and a newer web front end. This remote internship sits with the quality group in Oslo, which is currently proving that the web client can be tested as rigorously as the desktop one.

Responsibilities
• Write and maintain automated checks against the web scheduling client
• Reproduce customer-reported defects on supported browser versions
• Verify that release candidates behave identically across build targets
• Log clear, minimal reproduction steps for every defect you raise
• Review requirements documents and flag ambiguity before development

Requirements
• Studying toward a Bachelor's in computing or a related subject
• Some hands-on experience with a component or end-to-end test framework
• Understanding of why a staged, document-driven process suits this product
• Precision in written English, which is the working language
• Self-direction, since the team is distributed across four countries

Nice to have
• Exposure to a notebook environment for analysing test results
• Interest in accessibility standards for enterprise software

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Fairmont Textiles supplies woven fabric to furniture and automotive customers, and its mills now report production data to a shared platform. This junior cloud post supports that platform: nothing glamorous, everything load-bearing. The team is remote across the Netherlands and Portugal.

Responsibilities
• Maintain web and reverse-proxy tiers serving mill reporting applications
• Rebuild delivery pipelines that currently deploy by hand at month end
• Centralise application logs so mill IT can self-serve during incidents
• Keep Windows-based mill servers patched and documented
• Hand over cleanly at the end of each on-call rotation

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in computing or comparable practical experience
• One to two years supporting servers or cloud infrastructure
• Working knowledge of both Windows and Linux administration
• Ability to work independently from home without drifting
• Enough Dutch or Portuguese to speak to mill staff comfortably

Nice to have
• Exposure to charting tools used for operational reporting
• Interest in manufacturing systems and their constraints

jobs.title: Embedded Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Meridian Consulting places engineers into client programmes for six to eighteen months, and this post supports a connected-device client in the Randstad. You will work at the boundary between device firmware teams and the web services that receive their telemetry.

Responsibilities
• Build the service layer that ingests and validates device telemetry
• Create internal web tooling so support staff can inspect a device
• Design schemas that survive firmware versions shipping out of order
• Automate regression checks that run against real device recordings
• Write client-facing documentation to consultancy standards

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in electronics, computing or a related field
• Up to three years working near embedded or device-facing systems
• Understanding of transport security and why devices get it wrong
• Willingness to keep learning as each client stack differs
• Presentable, professional manner in client settings

Nice to have
• Experience with an enterprise relational database
• Exposure to automated testing tools in a device context
• Awareness of governance requirements in regulated industries

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Clearpoint Diagnostics runs its laboratory platforms across two regions, and results must arrive whether or not a data centre is having a bad day. This is an entry-level reliability post in Lisbon with structured mentoring for the first six months.

Responsibilities
• Codify environment builds so a region can be rebuilt from source
• Extend delivery pipelines with automated verification before release
• Instrument service-to-service traffic to find latency before customers do
• Take part in game days that rehearse regional failover
• Write post-incident notes that name causes rather than people

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in a technical subject
• Up to three years in infrastructure, support or a similar hands-on role
• Familiarity with version control and automated build tooling
• Comfort administering Windows servers as well as Linux hosts
• Calm, literal communication when systems are degraded

Nice to have
• Any exposure to charting operational data for a non-technical audience
• Interest in laboratory workflows and clinical turnaround times

jobs.title: Database Administrator
jobs.description:
About the role
Sandpiper Apparel's product, order and loyalty data now lives across several stores that grew separately. You will own day-to-day database work in Barcelona, keeping those stores fast during sale periods and moving them onto a consistent design as the platform team consolidates.

Responsibilities
• Design and review schema changes before they reach production
• Plan and execute migrations with tested rollback at every step
• Tune queries that slow down when campaign traffic triples
• Build and monitor the streams that move data between systems
• Advise application teams on modelling decisions early, not after release

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree and two to five years in a database-focused role
• Practical migration experience on systems that could not go offline
• Understanding of extract and load patterns between operational stores
• Diagnostic instinct when a slowdown has no obvious cause
• Comfort working on site with the merchandising systems team

Nice to have
• Exposure to embedded databases used in point-of-sale devices
• Appetite for continuing professional study
• Steadiness under pressure during peak trading weekends

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Sandpiper Apparel's Pune office builds the recommendation and demand models behind the storefront. You will own two production models end to end, from the data that feeds them to the metric the merchandising team argues about on Monday morning.

Responsibilities
• Own the training and release cycle for two live recommendation models
• Extract intent signals from product reviews and customer service text
• Rebuild reporting so model impact is visible next to trading figures
• Present results at sprint reviews attended by merchandising leads
• Run the retrospective when a model degrades, and act on its output

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in a numerate discipline
• Three to five years building models that reached real users
• Strong data manipulation skills and disciplined experiment tracking
• Ability to say clearly when a result is not significant
• Organised approach to work spanning several stakeholders

Nice to have
• Interest in statistical rigour beyond what the tooling enforces
• Track record of self-directed learning in a fast-moving field
• Experience working across a hybrid, multi-site team

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Osprey Telecom carries traffic for enterprise customers who read the security annexe of their contract carefully. The London security engineering team defends both the corporate estate and the systems that manage the network itself. This is a hands-on mid-level post, on site by design.

Responsibilities
• Harden Linux fleets and the cloud tenancy that supports network operations
• Review service-to-service traffic policy as more workloads move to mesh
• Lead remediation after external penetration tests, to agreed dates
• Assess vendor equipment before it reaches the production network
• Brief account teams on the security questions customers keep asking

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in computing, security or engineering
• Three to five years in an operational security role
• Deep Linux knowledge and working familiarity with a public cloud
• Numerate approach to risk, so priorities follow exposure and not noise
• Dependability during out-of-hours change windows

Nice to have
• Experience contributing to a security backlog inside an agile team
• Familiarity with work-tracking tools used across operations

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Vellum Financial runs payment and reconciliation services for mid-market lenders, and its platform group is fully remote across Central Europe. You will take ownership of the delivery and observability layer that every product team in the company depends on.

Responsibilities
• Operate and extend the shared container platform across environments
• Set service level objectives with product teams and hold them to them
• Reduce alert volume by removing signals nobody acts on
• Plan cluster capacity against forecast transaction volumes
• Manage certificate lifecycles before expiry becomes an incident

Requirements
• Four to seven years in infrastructure or platform engineering
• Production experience with container orchestration at meaningful scale
• Fluency with declarative infrastructure tooling and its review workflow
• Self-starting habits, as this team has no daily supervision
• Financial-sector discipline around change control and evidence

Nice to have
• Experience preparing operational data for audit reporting
• Comfort tidying messy operational datasets before analysis

jobs.title: Mobile Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Duncastle Rail equips maintenance crews and station staff with handheld applications that must work in tunnels, depots and open track. The Bangalore engineering centre owns those apps. You will take a lead hand in the customer-facing depot application.

Responsibilities
• Build and release depot and trackside applications for field crews
• Rework interface layers so screens stay legible in bright daylight
• Profile and fix battery and memory issues reported from depots
• Write concise release notes for crews with limited data connections
• Work with the backend team on offline-first synchronisation rules

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree and four to six years of mobile development
• Shipped applications to a production store or managed device fleet
• Confidence in a typed, compiled language and in styling mobile layouts
• Clear written English for handovers to the UK operations team
• Willingness to be on site with the depot team during rollouts

Nice to have
• Experience communicating with non-technical stakeholders on delivery risk
• Familiarity with modern frontend build tooling

jobs.title: Network Administrator
jobs.description:
About the role
Highfield Sports supplies equipment to clubs and schools across France, and its distribution and e-commerce estate has outgrown its network design. This Lyon post owns that network, on site with the operations team, as workloads shift toward managed cloud services.

Responsibilities
• Automate configuration for network and platform services across sites
• Codify cloud network topology instead of maintaining it by hand
• Instrument traffic so capacity decisions rest on evidence
• Plan the migration of depot connectivity onto the new design
• Present quarterly network plans to the operations director

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in networking, computing or engineering
• Two to six years running production networks or cloud infrastructure
• Practical configuration-management experience across mixed estates
• Ability to present a technical plan to a non-technical audience
• Working French and English

Nice to have
• Exposure to project scheduling practices used by the wider IT group
• Interest in large-scale analytics on network telemetry
• Experience contributing to sprint planning in a mixed ops team

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Thornfield Motors sells and services vehicles through 90 dealerships, and its dealer portal is where every sale is recorded. You will work on that portal from New York, in a codebase that spans a modern interface and older server-rendered pages the business still relies on.

Responsibilities
• Build dealer-facing screens and the server views behind them
• Modernise legacy pages without breaking bookmarked dealer workflows
• Coordinate release timing with dealership training schedules
• Maintain the reporting exports that finance reconciles against
• Review peers' work with attention to accuracy over style

Requirements
• Two to six years of professional web development
• Comfort moving between a modern framework and older templating code
• Willingness to maintain scripts written before you arrived
• Strong sense of ownership over data that ends up in financial records
• Ability to hold a delivery date and flag slippage early

Nice to have
• Experience working to a fixed departmental budget
• Familiarity with distributed collaboration across time zones
• Exposure to server-side frameworks outside your main stack

jobs.title: Systems Administrator
jobs.description:
About the role
Vellum Financial's Zurich office runs the estate that supports trading operations and internal services. This role keeps that estate consistent, automated and auditable, which matters more here than anywhere else in the business.

Responsibilities
• Automate server build and patch cycles across the hybrid estate
• Migrate remaining hand-built workloads onto managed cloud services
• Maintain web-tier configuration for internal and partner applications
• Prepare change evidence for internal audit each quarter
• Reduce manual steps in the deployment path for internal tooling

Requirements
• Three to six years administering production systems at scale
• Practical experience with a configuration-management tool
• Working knowledge of a major cloud platform and its identity model
• Discipline around change records, because auditors read them
• German and English, with Zurich office attendance three days weekly

Nice to have
• Interest in measuring the benefit an automation actually delivered
• Exposure to continuous delivery practices in a regulated setting
• Appetite for owning problems past the point of the immediate fix

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Vireo Environmental's Denver team builds the platform that ingests field readings and serves them to consultants writing regulatory reports. This systems post sits between application teams and infrastructure, and owns the parts nobody else quite owns.

Responsibilities
• Design and operate services that join field data to reporting workflows
• Manage infrastructure declaratively and review changes as code
• Package internal applications for repeatable deployment
• Improve log and metric coverage so failures are diagnosable
• Write the analytical queries that answer awkward client questions

Requirements
• Three to seven years across software and systems work
• Confidence writing and optimising queries against large tables
• Practical experience with declarative infrastructure and templating tools
• Judgement about which problems deserve engineering and which do not
• Hybrid attendance at the Denver office

Nice to have
• Familiarity with functional or concurrent language design
• Comfort with lightweight agile boards rather than heavy process
• Experience building dashboards consultants use unsupervised

jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Bluecrest Technologies is engaged on a twelve-month contract to raise the quality bar on a customer-facing product suite. You will work remotely inside their Stockholm team, embedded with developers rather than testing at arm's length after the fact.

Responsibilities
• Build automated coverage across web, mobile and service layers
• Verify API behaviour against contract before the interface is built
• Set entry and exit criteria for each release with the product owner
• Coach developers on writing tests they will actually maintain
• Report quality trends to stakeholders every two weeks

Requirements
• Two to five years in a senior-leaning quality engineering role
• Experience testing across more than one technology stack
• Confidence challenging a release decision with evidence
• Ability to be productive from day one on a fixed-term contract
• Composure when scope and priorities move mid-sprint

Nice to have
• Exposure to model-driven or data-driven test selection
• Familiarity with cost tracking on fixed-price engagements
• Ideas about testing practice that you are willing to defend

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Silverbrook Chemicals is on a two-year programme to move plant reporting and corporate applications to a public cloud. This contract post joins that programme remotely, focusing on the landing zones and network design that everything else will sit on.

Responsibilities
• Build landing zones and network topology as reviewed, versioned code
• Migrate reporting workloads off ageing Windows infrastructure
• Design event-driven services to replace scheduled batch jobs
• Run knowledge-transfer sessions so the permanent team can operate it
• Produce the migration schedule and keep it honest

Requirements
• Two to seven years in cloud or infrastructure engineering
• Hands-on delivery with at least one major cloud provider
• Fluency with infrastructure-as-code review and testing workflow
• Ability to work with plant IT staff whose first language is not English
• Contractor's habit of leaving documentation behind

Nice to have
• Numerical or analytical background useful for capacity modelling
• Experience with container orchestration at production scale
• Exposure to scheduling tools used across large migration programmes

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Amberwell Cosmetics sells direct and through retail partners, and its backend team in Madrid owns the services behind subscriptions, fulfilment and the ingredient traceability database that regulators can ask about at any time.

Responsibilities
• Design and build services for subscription and fulfilment workflows
• Reshape traceability data so batch history can be queried in seconds
• Split oversized tables before growth forces an emergency
• Improve internal reporting on returns and product complaints
• Take a defect from customer report to root cause without being chased

Requirements
• Three to seven years building backend services in production
• Solid grounding in algorithms and in reasoning about data volume
• Experience with analytical stores as well as transactional ones
• Self-direction, as this team is remote across Spain and Portugal
• Spanish and English

Nice to have
• Exposure to unified analytics platforms
• Ability to present findings visually to commercial colleagues
• Interest in regulatory traceability as a design constraint

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Vellum Financial's Oslo data team supplies the models and datasets that credit and risk functions depend on. You will own pipelines that must be right rather than merely fast, and you will be asked to show your working.

Responsibilities
• Build and maintain datasets serving credit risk and finance teams
• Run experiments that establish whether an observed effect is real
• Move model training code out of notebooks and into reviewed pipelines
• Document data lineage well enough to satisfy an internal auditor
• Work with analysts on site to understand what a field really means

Requirements
• Three to six years in data engineering or applied modelling
• Strong statistical judgement, including when to stop analysing
• Practical experience with an object-relational data access layer
• Written precision, since your notes become audit evidence
• On-site presence in Oslo, working alongside the risk function

Nice to have
• Exposure to retrieval-based approaches over document sets
• Familiarity with business intelligence tooling used by finance
• Steadiness when a reporting deadline compresses

jobs.title: Embedded Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Alpenglow Media produces broadcast and streaming content, and its Auckland engineering group builds the systems that move media between capture, edit and distribution. This role covers the devices and services at the capture end of that chain.

Responsibilities
• Build services that receive and index media from capture hardware
• Maintain the query layer editors use to find footage quickly
• Automate build and verification for firmware-adjacent components
• Keep replicated media stores consistent across two sites
• Support live production remotely during major broadcast events

Requirements
• Three to seven years in embedded, systems or media engineering
• Experience with continuous integration for hardware-adjacent software
• Comfort with both unit-level and interface-level testing
• Availability for occasional out-of-hours production support
• On-site work in Auckland with the production team

Nice to have
• Experience writing requirements documentation for hardware partners
• Familiarity with a modern Apple development language
• Exposure to enterprise database platforms used in media archives

jobs.title: Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Calderon Beverages runs bottling plants and a European distribution arm, and this Helsinki role joins the integration team that connects plant systems to the corporate ERP. Much of the estate is old, and none of it may stop.

Responsibilities
• Build interfaces between plant control systems and the corporate ERP
• Rewrite slow reporting queries that block month-end close
• Package deployments so plant IT can apply them in a maintenance window
• Modernise spreadsheet-based tools that the finance team still runs
• Coordinate change windows with two plants and one warehouse

Requirements
• Two to five years in integration or backend engineering
• Comfort reading and improving legacy business logic
• Experience tuning queries on a mature enterprise database
• Ability to work with colleagues who are not in the same office
• Finnish or Swedish alongside English

Nice to have
• Version control discipline in an environment that has lacked it
• Willingness to own an interface long after it has shipped

jobs.title: Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Northwind Systems is expanding automated coverage for its scheduling suite from Singapore, where the regional engineering hub sits. You will lead the effort to make the browser test suite fast enough that developers actually run it.

Responsibilities
• Design and maintain end-to-end suites across web and service layers
• Cut suite runtime so it fits inside the pull request feedback loop
• Test accessible behaviour with keyboard and screen reader paths
• Generate realistic test data at volume without touching customer records
• Mentor two junior testers joining this year

Requirements
• Three to seven years in test or quality engineering
• Experience with more than one frontend framework under test
• Practical grasp of accessibility requirements for enterprise buyers
• Skill in handling large datasets during performance testing
• Collaborative style with developers who own the code under test

Nice to have
• Familiarity with state management patterns in modern web applications
• Experience scoping quality work inside a fixed release window

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Thornfield Motors runs dealer-facing systems that dealerships open at eight and close at seven, six days a week. The Manchester reliability team keeps those hours uneventful. This role is on site with the operations group, close to the people who feel every outage.

Responsibilities
• Own reliability targets for dealer-facing services and report against them
• Codify infrastructure so environments stop drifting apart
• Improve release safety with staged rollout and automated rollback
• Lead incident response during business hours and write the review
• Plan capacity ahead of registration-plate change months

Requirements
• Four to five years in reliability, platform or infrastructure work
• Production experience with container orchestration
• Fluency across build pipelines, source hosting and deployment tooling
• Ability to run an incident calmly with a dealership director listening
• On-site presence in Manchester

Nice to have
• Experience hardening systems against a published control set
• Willingness to hand work to others rather than hold it
• Organised approach to a rota shared with three colleagues

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Fernbrook Pharmaceuticals is building internal tools for clinical operations from its Doha technology office, and this remote role covers both the interface and the service layer. Everything here is validated, so evidence matters as much as delivery.

Responsibilities
• Build validated internal applications for clinical operations teams
• Write and maintain the test evidence each release requires
• Design data access for studies that run for several years
• Work with quality colleagues to keep documentation release-ready
• Support the tools you build once they are in users' hands

Requirements
• Two to five years of full stack development
• Experience in an environment where documentation gates release
• Understanding of the commercial pressures behind a study timeline
• Ability to work remotely across Gulf and European hours
• Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline

Nice to have
• Exposure to analytics transformation tooling
• Experience with continuous integration in a validated environment
• Interest in life sciences beyond the software itself

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Ridgeway Industrial supplies components to aerospace and rail customers, and its Paris platform team provides the shared services every product team builds on. This role balances engineering with the internal advocacy that makes a platform get adopted.

Responsibilities
• Operate the shared build and runtime platform used by six product teams
• Distribute traffic across services during plant reporting peaks
• Run access reviews and close the findings they produce
• Make the case for platform investment to engineering leadership
• Retire duplicated tooling teams have built for themselves

Requirements
• Four to five years in platform, infrastructure or backend engineering
• Container and service-delivery experience in production
• Ability to write a short business case and defend the numbers
• Security-minded approach to shared infrastructure
• Hybrid attendance in Paris, with French as a working language

Nice to have
• Familiarity with scaled agile practice across multiple teams
• Experience presenting realised benefits after a platform change
• Exposure to a second cloud provider

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Marlin Marine Services maintains vessels and port equipment, and its Chicago software group builds the systems that schedule that work. This part-time post, three days a week, suits an experienced engineer who wants depth over hours.

Responsibilities
• Extend scheduling services used by port supervisors across four ports
• Replace ad-hoc data fetching with a consistent query interface
• Add browser coverage to the parts of the app nobody dares change
• Keep service communication observable as the estate grows
• Advise on technical debt priorities during quarterly planning

Requirements
• Four to five years of professional software engineering
• Backend experience with at least one mature server-side language
• Comfort choosing pragmatism over elegance in a small codebase
• Availability during core Chicago hours on working days
• Ability to leave clean handover notes at the end of each week

Nice to have
• Understanding of relational normalisation and when to break it
• Exposure to gradient-boosting methods for maintenance forecasting

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
About the role
Granite Peak Energy's Hamburg analytics group forecasts generation and price exposure for the trading desk. This part-time post, remote and three days a week, focuses on the forecasting models rather than the reporting around them.

Responsibilities
• Build and retrain generation forecasts against weather and turbine data
• Run structured search over model settings rather than manual guessing
• Quantify the relationship between forecast error and trading loss
• Present model behaviour to traders who will challenge every assumption
• Keep experiment records so results can be reproduced months later

Requirements
• Three to seven years in applied modelling or data science
• Regression and classification experience on time-dependent data
• Discipline about data cleaning before modelling begins
• Confidence presenting uncertainty to a commercially minded audience
• Availability across three fixed days each week

Nice to have
• Precision in reporting results that could move a trading decision
• Comfort producing clear visual explanations of model behaviour

jobs.title: Database Administrator
jobs.description:
About the role
Northwind Systems is consolidating its Sydney data estate under a nine-month contract. You will own the database side of that programme: what moves, in what order, and what breaks if it moves in the wrong one.

Responsibilities
• Plan and run migrations between operational and analytical stores
• Redesign indexing strategy on the tables that dominate query cost
• Split the largest datasets before growth forces an unplanned outage
• Facilitate design sessions with the three teams affected
• Publish and maintain the migration schedule for stakeholders

Requirements
• Two to seven years of database engineering or administration
• Migration experience across more than one database technology
• Working knowledge of messaging and transformation tooling in pipelines
• Ability to chair a meeting between teams that disagree
• Fully remote working with Australian-hours overlap

Nice to have
• Familiarity with mature enterprise database platforms
• Exposure to partitioning strategies at multi-terabyte scale
• Comfort with planning tools used by the programme office

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Northwind Systems' Manchester office is adding intelligent scheduling suggestions to its core product. You will take those models from prototype to a supported production feature used by enterprise customers.

Responsibilities
• Productionise scheduling models and own their release cadence
• Extract structure from free-text task descriptions customers write
• Define the metrics that decide whether a model version ships
• Reason about failure cases before customers discover them
• Work on site with product managers to shape the feature

Requirements
• Four to five years in machine learning or applied data work
• Experience deploying models into a product, not only into a report
• Strong tabular data skills and tree-based modelling experience
• Critical habit of asking what a metric is actually measuring
• On-site presence in Manchester

Nice to have
• Statistical training beyond applied practice
• Ability to explain model behaviour in a customer-facing document
• Experience with sequence or seasonality effects in usage data

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Windermere Hotels operates 60 properties and a central booking platform holding a great deal of guest data. This part-time security post, three days a week on site in Chicago, covers detection and response for that platform.

Responsibilities
• Run detection and response for booking and loyalty platforms
• Build security checks into delivery pipelines used by property IT
• Investigate access anomalies across property and corporate systems
• Improve log coverage so investigations do not stall at hour two
• Brief property managers after any guest-affecting incident

Requirements
• Two to six years in security operations or engineering
• Practical detection work with a log analytics platform
• Understanding of identity controls across a distributed estate
• Steadiness and tact when an incident involves a colleague
• Availability three fixed days per week on site

Nice to have
• Exposure to classification techniques for alert triage
• Experience contributing to sprint-based security backlogs
• Interest in hospitality data protection obligations

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Harborline Group runs shipping and terminal operations, and its Madrid technology centre supports both. This DevOps role covers the delivery and infrastructure layer for terminal-facing applications where downtime has a berth-schedule cost.

Responsibilities
• Automate provisioning and configuration across terminal environments
• Build delivery pipelines that replace manual weekend deployments
• Forecast infrastructure capacity against seasonal cargo volumes
• Coordinate security testing and track findings to closure
• Plan platform work quarterly alongside terminal operations

Requirements
• Four to five years in DevOps, platform or infrastructure engineering
• Experience automating mixed Windows and Linux estates
• Cloud delivery experience with genuine production responsibility
• Ability to plan work against a fixed operational calendar
• Composure during peak periods when everything arrives at once

Nice to have
• Interest in offensive testing to inform defensive design
• Familiarity with web-tier tuning under sustained load
• Spanish alongside English for the terminal teams

jobs.title: Mobile Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Vireo Environmental gives field inspectors a mobile application they use in places with no signal and a lot of mud. The Warsaw team owns it. You will lead the work to make the app faster and less fragile in the field.

Responsibilities
• Build and maintain the inspector application for field use
• Rework the offline sync layer so no reading is ever lost
• Improve interface responsiveness on the ageing devices inspectors carry
• Work with the backend team on the APIs the app depends on
• Join two field days a year to see the app used in real conditions

Requirements
• Four to six years of mobile or cross-platform development
• Experience with an application that must work without connectivity
• Backend familiarity, since this team writes both ends
• Willingness to work on site in Warsaw with the platform team
• Polish and English

Nice to have
• Interest in natural language handling for inspection note capture
• Exposure to real-time communication between device and server
• Patience for debugging problems that only appear at a wind farm

jobs.title: Network Administrator
jobs.description:
About the role
Nordvik Frozen Foods runs cold-chain distribution across Benelux, and its Brussels IT team keeps the networks connecting warehouses, vehicles and head office. This role owns network and access infrastructure, on site where the racks are.

Responsibilities
• Operate network and access infrastructure across four cold stores
• Manage identity and access policy for warehouse and driver systems
• Support the container platform hosting warehouse applications
• Renew and monitor certificates across internal and partner systems
• Keep network documentation accurate enough to use during an outage

Requirements
• Two to seven years in network or infrastructure administration
• Practical experience with orchestrated container environments
• Working knowledge of access control models in a mixed estate
• Absolute reliability, because cold-chain failures spoil stock
• Dutch or French alongside English

Nice to have
• Experience forecasting infrastructure capacity against growth
• Willingness to mentor the apprentice joining the team
• Comfort writing to a non-technical audience

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Beacon Ridge Education builds learning platforms used by universities across the DACH region. The Munich frontend team owns the student-facing experience, which spans web and two mobile clients built from a shared design language.

Responsibilities
• Build student-facing interfaces across web and mobile clients
• Maintain the shared component library the three clients consume
• Support older browser targets that university estates still run
• Improve build performance so releases stop taking half a day
• Review interface work from the two junior engineers on the team

Requirements
• Three to five years of frontend engineering
• Experience with at least one cross-platform mobile framework
• Care with correctness in a product students depend on for assessment
• Ability to work remotely with structured written communication
• German at a working level

Nice to have
• Interest in on-device model use for accessibility features
• Familiarity with automated testing on the JVM, which the backend uses
• Exposure to legacy systems that still hold student records

jobs.title: Systems Administrator
jobs.description:
About the role
Harborline Group's London office supports corporate systems for a shipping business with offices in nine countries. This systems role is remote-first and covers the cloud estate that corporate applications now run on.

Responsibilities
• Administer cloud infrastructure supporting corporate applications
• Replace scheduled server tasks with event-driven equivalents
• Maintain perimeter and identity controls across regions
• Lead response for infrastructure incidents affecting head office systems
• Reduce the manual runbook steps your team repeats each month

Requirements
• Two to five years of systems or cloud administration
• Experience with a major cloud provider's core services
• Understanding of network boundary controls in a distributed estate
• Ownership mindset, since remote work removes the safety net of proximity
• Availability for a shared on-call rota

Nice to have
• Experience introducing service mesh or similar traffic controls
• Comfort improving monitoring coverage rather than tolerating gaps
• Interest in shipping and the operational rhythm behind it

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Sandpiper Apparel's Birmingham engineering group builds the internal services behind pricing, stock and supplier integration. This remote role is broad by design: you will write services, script infrastructure and occasionally build the tooling the team needs.

Responsibilities
• Build and operate internal services supporting pricing and stock
• Automate the operational tasks the team currently does by hand
• Containerise services so environments are reproducible
• Prototype assistant tooling for internal supplier queries
• Review code across several languages the team maintains

Requirements
• Three to seven years across backend and systems engineering
• Fluency in more than one language, and willingness to learn another
• Practical shell and container skills, not just theoretical ones
• Analytical approach to problems with no obvious right answer
• Self-management, as the team is remote across the UK

Nice to have
• Exposure to graph-based API design
• Familiarity with classical machine learning libraries
• Interest in retail supply chain problems

jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Ardent Logistics is raising the quality bar on its customer-facing shipment tracking products. This remote Manchester-based role sits inside a delivery squad, testing continuously rather than at the end.

Responsibilities
• Own the test strategy for the shipment tracking product area
• Automate journeys across the customer portal and its service layer
• Verify tracking pages work for users relying on assistive technology
• Run refinement sessions to define acceptance criteria up front
• Report quality signals to the product owner each sprint

Requirements
• Two to five years of quality engineering in an agile team
• Automation experience across browser and service layers
• Understanding of accessibility standards and how to test against them
• Ability to work with colleagues across several European languages
• Comfort influencing without authority inside a squad

Nice to have
• Experience contributing to release scope and risk discussions
• Familiarity with scheduling tools used by the delivery office
• Interest in building the case for further quality investment

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Osprey Telecom's Oslo engineering site runs the cloud estate behind network management and customer portals. This role covers the operational side of that estate, on site with the network operations centre.

Responsibilities
• Operate cloud infrastructure supporting network management systems
• Automate deployment so releases stop depending on individuals
• Lead technical response during infrastructure incidents
• Track and close vulnerability findings across cloud workloads
• Model traffic growth to inform capacity decisions

Requirements
• Two to seven years of cloud or infrastructure engineering
• Production experience with orchestration and event-driven services
• Working knowledge of certificate and identity management at scale
• Willingness to join a 24/7 escalation rota shared with four engineers
• Norwegian or Swedish alongside English

Nice to have
• Experience quantifying the benefit of an infrastructure change
• Deep Linux troubleshooting beyond the usual command set
• Interest in telecom network architecture

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Foxglove Interiors sells furnishings online across three markets, and its Bangalore engineering centre builds the services behind catalogue, search and fulfilment. This nine-month contract covers a backend rebuild that must land before the autumn season.

Responsibilities
• Rebuild catalogue and search services to a documented interface contract
• Group product data to improve recommendations without a full model rewrite
• Design the analytical store feeding merchandising reporting
• Add automated coverage to the services you touch
• Hand over cleanly to the permanent team at contract end

Requirements
• Two to seven years of backend engineering
• Strong grounding in algorithms and data structure choices
• Experience with modern Python service frameworks
• Ability to be productive quickly in an unfamiliar codebase
• Remote working with substantial overlap into European hours

Nice to have
• Familiarity with systems languages for performance-critical paths
• Exposure to retrieval techniques over product content
• Constructive approach when technical opinions differ

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Harborline Group's Dubai office builds the reporting estate used by terminal and chartering teams. This data engineering role owns the pipelines behind those reports and, increasingly, the cost of running them.

Responsibilities
• Build and maintain pipelines feeding terminal and chartering reports
• Model vessel and cargo history so trends survive schema changes
• Keep replicated reporting stores in step with operational systems
• Track and reduce the running cost of the reporting platform
• Work with commercial analysts to turn questions into datasets

Requirements
• Two to six years in data engineering
• Production experience with an enterprise relational platform
• Understanding of replication behaviour and its failure modes
• Commercial awareness, since this platform has a visible budget
• Hybrid attendance at the Dubai office

Nice to have
• Exposure to retrieval-based tooling over shipping documentation
• Habit of cleaning data before it reaches an analyst
• Experience running retrospectives that change something

jobs.title: Embedded Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Quarry Lane Foods runs production lines that report through embedded controllers into a plant historian. The Oslo engineering team owns the software between the two. This part-time post, three days a week, covers the data path from line to report.

Responsibilities
• Maintain embedded services collecting output data from production lines
• Optimise historian queries that plant managers run every morning
• Move reporting logic out of stored procedures into reviewed code
• Build shift dashboards that line supervisors can read at a glance
• Support commissioning when a new line is installed

Requirements
• Three to seven years in embedded, systems or industrial software
• Comfort at a shell prompt on constrained industrial hardware
• Experience tuning transactional database workloads
• Understanding of the commercial cost of an unplanned line stop
• Availability three fixed days weekly, hybrid to the Oslo plant

Nice to have
• Exposure to a compiled systems language for controller-side work
• Interest in defining requirements alongside production staff
• Sound time management across two parallel plant projects

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Onyx Payments settles card and account-to-account transactions for merchants across North America, and correctness is not negotiable. You will be one of three senior engineers on the settlement domain, working remotely, and you will be trusted to say when a design is not ready.

Responsibilities
• Design and build settlement services that reconcile to the cent
• Own schema and index decisions for the ledger's busiest tables
• Modernise merchant-facing screens still running on older libraries
• Lead design review for changes touching money movement
• Mentor two mid-level engineers through their first ledger work

Requirements
• Eight to twelve years of professional software engineering
• Production experience with concurrent, fault-tolerant server systems
• Database ownership beyond writing queries, including recovery planning
• Judgement about when a small manual process beats an automated one
• Written clarity, since design decisions here outlive their authors

Nice to have
• Familiarity with PHP frameworks still present in merchant tooling
• Habit of testing APIs interactively before writing client code
• Payments or regulated financial experience

jobs.title: Systems Administrator
jobs.description:
About the role
Kestrel Analytics sells analytics products to insurers, and its infrastructure is entirely cloud-hosted and entirely code-defined. This senior systems role is remote and carries real authority over how environments are built and how much they cost.

Responsibilities
• Own the infrastructure codebase and the review standards around it
• Forecast capacity and cost across customer-facing environments
• Replace long-lived servers with event-driven and managed services
• Facilitate architecture sessions between platform and product teams
• Publish infrastructure health reporting for the leadership team

Requirements
• Master's degree or equivalent depth in a technical field
• Seven to twelve years of systems and cloud engineering
• Deep experience defining infrastructure declaratively across environments
• Ability to run a room where two teams want different things
• Comfort presenting cost and capacity data to non-engineers

Nice to have
• Exposure to operating machine learning systems in production
• Familiarity with governance requirements in the insurance sector
• Experience with staged delivery on customer-committed dates

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer

Bluecrest Technologies builds forecasting products sold to retailers, and this senior role sits between research and the product teams that ship it. Remote, Seattle-anchored, with a strong bias toward results that survive contact with a customer's data.

Responsibilities
• Take forecasting models from research through to supported release
• Design the experiments that decide whether a change is genuinely better
• Rebuild feature preparation so training data matches production data
• Publish model behaviour dashboards for customer success teams
• Set the modelling standards the wider team is reviewed against

Requirements
• Six to twelve years of applied machine learning
• Rigour with experimental design, including sample size and stopping rules
• Deep numerical computing skills on large arrays and frames
• Track record of models that stayed reliable after launch
• Ability to work remotely with high autonomy

Nice to have
• Practical experience with large language models in a product context
• Familiarity with business intelligence tooling used by customers
• Interest in retail demand behaviour

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Ashcombe Packaging supplies food and pharmaceutical packaging across Central Europe, and its Prague software group builds the systems that quote, plan and track every order. This senior remote role owns the core order platform.

Responsibilities
• Own architecture and delivery for the order and quoting platform
• Rewrite pricing logic that currently lives in three incompatible places
• Define infrastructure as reviewed code rather than console clicks
• Set coding standards across a codebase spanning several languages
• Advise the commercial team on what a requested change really costs

Requirements
• Eight to twelve years of professional software engineering
• Depth in at least one concurrent, compiled language used in production
• Experience owning a system through more than one major rewrite
• Analytical approach to trade-offs between speed and safety
• Czech or German alongside English

Nice to have
• Willingness to maintain scientific legacy code the plants still depend on
• Exposure to modern frontend frameworks for internal tooling

jobs.title: Network Administrator
jobs.description:
About the role
Trellis Property Group manages commercial buildings across Europe, and its network estate reaches every one of them. This senior role owns that estate remotely, leads two engineers, and represents the network in front of building owners.

Responsibilities
• Own network architecture across corporate and building-systems estates
• Automate configuration so site builds are repeatable and auditable
• Lead vulnerability remediation across network and building controllers
• Present network plans and incident findings to property owners
• Line-manage two engineers, including their development plans

Requirements
• Five to eleven years in network engineering, some at senior level
• Strong configuration-management and pipeline automation experience
• Practical firewall and segmentation design across mixed estates
• Confidence presenting to a commercial audience with money at stake
• Experience leading people, not only projects

Nice to have
• Interest in anomaly detection over network telemetry
• Familiarity with work-tracking tools used by facilities teams
• Direct, dependable communication style

jobs.title: Embedded Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Tidewater Shipping builds the onboard and shoreside systems that track cargo condition in transit. This senior role covers the shoreside services that receive vessel data, and the London team works closely with crews across six nationalities.

• Own the shoreside services ingesting vessel and container telemetry
• Migrate a decade of voyage history onto a supportable data platform
• Extract structure from free-text crew reports for incident analysis
• Replace stored-procedure business logic with reviewed application code
• Support the onboard team when a device behaves differently at sea

Requirements
• Seven to nine years across embedded and backend engineering
• Experience with a systems language where memory behaviour matters
• Practical database migration work on live operational systems
• Ability to work with colleagues whose English is a second language
• Hybrid attendance in London

Nice to have
• Comfort with agile ceremonies without treating them as sacred
• Familiarity with lightweight work-tracking tools
• Maritime or logistics domain experience

jobs.title: Database Administrator

Bluecrest Technologies runs a data estate that serves both product analytics and customer-facing reporting. This senior remote role owns those databases: their design, their backups, and the honest answer to whether a restore has been tested.

Responsibilities
• Own backup, recovery and retention policy across the data estate
• Design analytical schemas that survive changes to source systems
• Tune messaging and queue behaviour where data moves between systems
• Test restores on a schedule and publish the evidence
• Advise application teams on data access patterns before code is written

Requirements
• Six to twelve years in database engineering or administration
• Proven recovery planning, tested rather than documented
• Experience with both analytical and transactional workloads
• Analytical mind that pursues a discrepancy rather than rounding it away
• Ability to work remotely with minimal supervision

Nice to have
• Exposure to document databases alongside relational ones
• Experience teaching database practice to application engineers
• Familiarity with programme-level reporting and its data demands

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Kestrel Analytics is standing up a regional data platform in Doha to serve Gulf insurance clients. This senior role owns the pipelines and the change process around them, working hybrid with a small local team and a larger group in Europe.

Responsibilities
• Own the ingestion and transformation layer for regional client data
• Run the change process for pipeline releases affecting live clients
• Build the operational layer that keeps deployed models supportable
• Extract structured fields from claims narratives at scale
• Report platform status weekly to regional leadership

• Six to eleven years in data engineering

• Practical change management in an environment with named clients
• Strong customer instincts, since clients are close by here
• Hybrid attendance in Doha and occasional regional travel

Nice to have
• Interest in query cost as a first-class design concern
• Experience leading a small team through a platform migration
• Familiarity with governance expectations in insurance

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Kestrel Analytics runs its production platform from Munich, and cloud spend has become a board-level topic. This senior role owns delivery tooling and the cost profile of the platform it deploys to.

• Own build and deployment tooling used by every engineering team
• Reduce cloud spend without degrading customer-facing performance
• Codify environment definitions so staging genuinely matches production
• Manage cluster networking as workloads grow across regions
• Coordinate infrastructure vendors and hold them to their commitments

• Five to nine years in DevOps or platform engineering

• Demonstrated cost reduction with the numbers to back it up

• Hybrid attendance in Munich, with German useful but not required

Nice to have

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer

Windermere Hotels runs its booking and property systems on cloud infrastructure that grew fast and was tidied late. This senior role in New York owns that estate, with a mandate to make it cheaper, quieter and more predictable.

Responsibilities
• Own cloud architecture for booking and property management systems
• Cut infrastructure spend against a target agreed with finance
• Build observability that shows guest-facing impact, not just server health
• Detect unusual traffic patterns before they become booking failures
• Partner with property IT on the systems they run locally

• Six to eleven years of cloud or infrastructure engineering

• Genuine service orientation toward property teams as customers

• Experience with perimeter controls across distributed properties

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer

Beacon Ridge Education serves universities across Asia-Pacific from Singapore, and term-start week is its equivalent of peak trading. This senior reliability role sits on site with the operations team that carries that week.

• Own availability targets for student-facing platforms during term start

• Tune web and proxy tiers for enrolment traffic spikes
• Lead major incident response and chair the review afterwards
• Present reliability performance to university customers each term

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer

jobs.title: Test Automation Engineer

jobs.title: Integration Engineer

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
