Fairmont Textiles sells woven fabric to furniture makers and interior contractors, and its New York desk covers the north-east trade. This nine-month contract seat handles inbound enquiries and the smaller reorder accounts that keep the mill's shorter runs full.

Responsibilities
• Work inbound enquiries and qualify them against mill capacity
• Grow reorder volume from existing accounts in your postcode list
• Present swatch programmes to buyers over video and in the showroom
• Keep every conversation logged the same day it happens
• Hand larger opportunities to the field team with a clean brief

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent commercial experience
• Up to three years in a sales or customer-facing commercial role
• Confidence making the second and third call, not just the first
• Comfort quoting from a price list with margin rules attached
• On-site presence at the New York showroom five days a week

Nice to have
• Interest in textiles, interiors or the furniture trade
• Experience segmenting a customer list rather than working it alphabetically
• Familiarity with email campaign tools used for swatch promotions

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Halcyon Travel sells booking and itinerary software to tour operators, and the Sydney team pairs a commercial lead with a technical one on every deal. This is the junior technical seat: you demonstrate the product and answer the questions the account executive cannot.

Responsibilities
• Run product demonstrations tailored to each operator's booking flow
• Build proof-of-concept configurations during evaluation periods
• Answer technical questions in writing within one working day
• Capture requirements accurately so implementation inherits the truth
• Support onboarding for the first month after each deal closes

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in a business or technical subject
• Up to three years in a customer-facing or product support role
• Ability to explain software clearly to a non-technical operator
• Curiosity about how a customer actually runs their business
• On-site presence in Sydney with occasional operator visits

Nice to have
• Travel industry experience from any angle
• Comfort producing simple visuals for a proposal deck
• Experience coordinating your own diary across several live deals

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
About the role
Kestrel Analytics sells analytics products to insurers, and every deal starts with someone willing to make the call. This New York seat opens conversations with underwriting and claims leaders across North America and continental Europe.

Responsibilities
• Open conversations with underwriting and claims leaders by phone
• Research each account before dialling so the first line is relevant
• Handle the standard objections without reading from a card
• Book qualified meetings and brief the account executive properly
• Hit weekly activity and meeting targets that are published openly

Requirements
• Diploma or equivalent, with one to two years of outbound experience
• Genuine comfort with cold outreach and the rejection that comes with it
• A second European language for the continental accounts
• Discipline with the pipeline system, since the whole team reads it
• On-site presence in New York, where the floor works together

Nice to have
• Interest in insurance as an industry, not just as a target list
• Experience contributing to social selling alongside phone outreach
• Exposure to reseller or partner-led selling

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
About the role
Fairmont Textiles is running a twelve-month commercial internship attached to its enterprise accounts team in Copenhagen. You will support the two executives covering Nordic furniture manufacturers, and you will be given real accounts rather than filing work.

Responsibilities
• Prepare tender responses and pricing sheets for enterprise bids
• Maintain the forecast for the Nordic account portfolio
• Sit in on customer meetings and write the follow-up notes
• Track sample requests through the mill to delivery
• Present one account review to the commercial director each quarter

Requirements
• Diploma or ongoing degree study in business or commerce
• One to three years of work experience, including part-time roles
• Careful written Danish and English
• Willingness to learn how a mill actually prices a fabric run
• Hybrid attendance in Copenhagen

Nice to have
• Familiarity with document collaboration tools used across the team
• Experience delivering training or presentations to a group
• Interest in a permanent commercial role afterwards

jobs.title: Sales Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
About the role
Thornfield Motors runs a dealer network of ninety sites, and the sales operations team keeps the commercial data behind it honest. This remote junior seat supports dealer performance reporting and the systems that feed it, from Krakow.

Responsibilities
• Maintain dealer performance reporting and chase missing submissions
• Support dealers using the group's lead management system
• Reconcile lead sources between dealer systems and the group platform
• Call dealer principals about data gaps rather than emailing twice
• Prepare the monthly commercial pack for regional managers

Requirements
• Diploma in business, commerce or a numerate subject
• One to two years in a commercial, analyst or sales support role
• Comfort working with data from systems that disagree with each other
• Honesty about numbers, especially when they are unflattering
• Polish and English, working remotely with UK hours overlap

Nice to have
• Exposure to how systems exchange data through interfaces
• Interest in retail automotive commercial models
• Experience supporting a business system rollout

jobs.title: Sales Enablement Specialist
jobs.description:
About the role
Highfield Sports supplies clubs, schools and independent retailers across the UK, and the enablement function is new. This remote junior role helps field sellers spend more time selling and less time rebuilding the same proposal.

Responsibilities
• Build and maintain the proposal and pricing templates the field uses
• Run onboarding sessions for new sellers in their first fortnight
• Collect the objections sellers hear and turn them into usable answers
• Maintain the partner price files that retailers work from
• Sit in on live calls each month to keep the material grounded

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in a commercial or communications subject
• One to two years in sales, sales support or a training-adjacent role
• Clear written English, because your work is read without you present
• Willingness to make outbound calls yourself so the advice stays real
• Self-management, since the team is remote across the UK

Nice to have
• Interest in how conversion improves through better preparation
• Exposure to point-of-sale systems used by independent retailers
• Experience running a retrospective and acting on it

jobs.title: Retail Sales Associate
jobs.description:
About the role
Juniper Networks Group runs a small retail arm selling networking hardware to Auckland businesses. This twelve-month internship covers the shop floor and the accounts behind it, splitting time between the store and the office.

Responsibilities
• Serve walk-in trade customers and match products to their needs
• Maintain shelf layout and stock presentation across the store
• Follow up quotes that have gone quiet after a week
• Keep customer records current in the sales system
• Support the small-business account manager with territory admin

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree or ongoing study in business or a related field
• One to three years of retail, hospitality or customer-facing work
• Organised approach to a day with constant interruptions
• Willingness to learn enough about networking to be useful
• Hybrid pattern across store and office in Auckland

Nice to have
• Confidence handling a customer who arrives already annoyed
• Interest in progressing into a territory sales role
• Exposure to planning tools used by the wider team

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
About the role
Sandpiper Apparel sells wholesale to independent boutiques across the Nordics, and this Stockholm seat covers a defined list of accounts. It is an early-career role with a real book of business from month two.

Responsibilities
• Own a list of sixty boutique accounts through the seasonal buying cycle
• Present each collection and build the buy with the store owner
• Recover accounts that skipped a season, with a specific proposal
• Coordinate delivery issues between the boutique and the warehouse
• Report weekly on order intake against the seasonal plan

Requirements
• Diploma in business, fashion commerce or equivalent experience
• Up to three years in wholesale, retail or account-facing sales
• Ability to handle a difficult delivery conversation without escalating it
• Numerate approach to margin and sell-through discussion
• Hybrid attendance in Stockholm; Swedish and English

Nice to have
• Genuine interest in the independent retail scene
• Experience running email campaigns to a buyer list
• Instinct for when to widen an order rather than discount it

jobs.title: Territory Sales Representative
jobs.description:
About the role
Marlin Marine Services sells maintenance contracts and chandlery to commercial operators around the Great Lakes. This territory seat works from the Toronto office and spends a good part of each week on the docks.

Responsibilities
• Cover the Ontario territory, visiting operators at their berths
• Quote maintenance contracts against vessel schedules and budgets
• Negotiate renewal terms with operators who know their costs well
• Log every visit so the service team can plan around it
• Attend two trade shows a year and work the stand properly

Requirements
• Diploma in business, marine studies or equivalent trade experience
• One to three years selling to business customers
• Willingness to spend most of the week away from a desk
• Composure negotiating with operators who will push hard on price
• Full driving licence and comfort around working vessels

Nice to have
• Marine, industrial or heavy equipment background
• Experience improving a clumsy quoting process
• Exposure to coordinating third-party service suppliers

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
About the role
Silverbrook Chemicals sells cleaning and coating products to trade customers through a direct channel. This remote seat, anchored to Lyon, handles smaller trade and consumer accounts across France by phone and video.

Responsibilities
• Convert inbound trade enquiries into first orders within two weeks
• Qualify enquiries against the safety and volume rules the plant sets
• Negotiate annual pricing for repeat trade customers
• Introduce complementary lines to accounts buying one product only
• Keep the customer record clean enough to forecast from

Requirements
• Diploma in commerce or equivalent commercial experience
• One to three years of telephone or field sales
• Ability to persuade without overpromising on a regulated product
• Comfort working from home with structured daily targets
• French and English

Nice to have
• Exposure to a data migration between commercial systems
• Interest in chemical safety requirements as a selling constraint
• Confidence presenting to a small group of trade buyers

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Brightwater Utilities supplies metering and leak detection equipment to municipal water authorities. This junior technical sales seat in Madrid supports bids across Spain and Portugal, where the buyer is usually an engineer and always a public body.

Responsibilities
• Support tenders for municipal metering and detection projects
• Configure equipment proposals against each authority's specification
• Train distributor staff on the product range twice a quarter
• Maintain the equipment and pricing data used in every bid
• Follow up existing authorities on expansion of installed schemes

Requirements
• Diploma in engineering, business or a technical subject
• Up to three years in technical sales or customer-facing support
• Ability to read a public tender specification and answer it exactly
• Spanish and Portuguese, or Spanish with willingness to learn
• Hybrid attendance in Madrid with regional travel

Nice to have
• Interest in water conservation as a policy driver
• Exposure to service desk tooling used for post-sale support
• Experience supporting customer acceptance testing

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
About the role
Ironvale Manufacturing is opening a Toronto sales development function to reach mid-market manufacturers directly rather than through distributors. This twelve-month internship is the first seat in it, on site with the commercial team.

Responsibilities
• Build the prospect list for mid-market manufacturers in Ontario
• Qualify inbound and outbound leads against the fit criteria agreed
• Book plant visits for the field sales team and prepare the brief
• Test outreach messages and report what actually gets replies
• Document the process so the next hire does not start from zero

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree or ongoing study in business or engineering
• One to two years of work experience in any customer-facing setting
• Willingness to be the first person doing an unproven job
• Clear note-taking, because the process is being written as you go
• On-site presence in Toronto

Nice to have
• Interest in manufacturing and how plants actually buy
• Comfort delivering a short training session to peers
• Experience with shared document workspaces

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
About the role
Silverbrook Chemicals is building a direct enterprise channel for its speciality coatings, selling to manufacturers rather than through distributors. This remote seat covers the western United States and reports into the Seattle commercial lead.

Responsibilities
• Develop enterprise manufacturing accounts across the western states
• Run multi-stakeholder evaluations involving plant, quality and procurement
• Build the commercial case that survives a procurement review
• Coordinate technical trials at customer plants with the lab team
• Maintain an accurate forecast the plant can plan production against

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in a commercial, chemical or technical subject
• One to two years of business-to-business selling
• Ability to read a room where the technical and commercial buyers disagree
• Steadiness when a deal cycle runs longer than a quarter
• Remote working with regular travel to customer plants

Nice to have
• Exposure to enterprise resource systems used by manufacturers
• Interest in coatings, materials or industrial chemistry
• Comfort building a customer's business case with them

jobs.title: Sales Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
About the role
Beacon Ridge Education sells learning platforms to institutions, and the Vancouver sales operations seat keeps the commercial engine measurable. This is an analytical role inside a sales team, on site with the people whose numbers you report.

Responsibilities
• Produce weekly pipeline and conversion reporting for the sales floor
• Investigate discrepancies between reported and actual close rates
• Maintain territory definitions and account assignment rules
• Support the quarterly commission calculation with clean data
• Take on outbound calling one morning a week to stay grounded

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in business, economics or a numerate subject
• One to two years in sales operations, analysis or a sales role
• Numeracy strong enough to catch an error before a director does
• Willingness to challenge a seller's optimistic forecast politely
• On-site presence in Vancouver

Nice to have
• Interest in what actually moves conversion rates
• Exposure to onboarding customers after the sale
• Familiarity with paid acquisition channels feeding the pipeline

jobs.title: Sales Enablement Specialist
jobs.description:
About the role
Nordvik Frozen Foods is expanding into Gulf food service, and the Dubai team needs someone to equip its distributors properly. This enablement seat sits between the commercial team and the partners who actually meet the customer.

Responsibilities
• Build the sales materials distributors use across the Gulf region
• Onboard new distributor sales teams within their first month
• Run product knowledge sessions covering cold-chain requirements
• Maintain the customer records shared between us and our partners
• Report distributor activity levels to the regional manager monthly

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in business, food science or a related field
• One to three years in sales, distribution or partner support
• Ability to teach a group whose first language is not English
• Organised approach to material that changes with each product launch
• Hybrid attendance in Dubai with regional travel

Nice to have
• Interest in cold-chain logistics and where it goes wrong
• Experience helping close a deal rather than only supporting one
• Exposure to sales performance reporting

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About the role
Larkspur Biotech sells reagents and instruments to research laboratories, and once a lab standardises on a platform the relationship runs for years. This Seattle role protects and grows those relationships across the Pacific Northwest.

Responsibilities
• Own renewals and expansion across forty laboratory accounts
• Run quarterly reviews with lab directors on consumption and outcomes
• Spot the early signals that a lab is evaluating an alternative
• Coordinate instrument service escalations until they are genuinely closed
• Grow consumables volume alongside instrument placements

Requirements
• Diploma in a life science or commercial subject
• Two to five years in account management or laboratory sales
• Ability to hold a technical conversation with a principal investigator
• Time discipline across a portfolio too large to visit weekly
• Hybrid attendance in Seattle with regional travel

Nice to have
• Bench experience in a research or clinical laboratory
• Exposure to enterprise systems used for order management
• Interest in reviewing what went wrong after a lost account

jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.description:
About the role
Windermere Hotels is pushing into corporate and conference business across northern Germany, and this twelve-month contract seat leads that effort remotely from Hamburg. The properties are ready; the corporate pipeline is not.

Responsibilities
• Develop corporate and conference accounts across northern Germany
• Negotiate annual rate agreements with corporate travel managers
• Run site visits at properties for prospective conference clients
• Coach property sales staff on handling corporate enquiries
• Report progress against the contract's agreed targets monthly

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent commercial experience
• Two to five years in business development, ideally in hospitality
• Confidence negotiating rates against national chain competition
• Ability to produce results inside a fixed contract period
• German and English, remote with frequent property visits

Nice to have
• Existing relationships with corporate travel buyers in the region
• Experience demonstrating a booking system to a client
• Exposure to allocating limited sales resource across properties

jobs.title: Sales Enablement Specialist
jobs.description:
About the role
Trellis Property Group sells building management services to commercial landlords, and its enablement function supports a field team spread across France. This Lyon-based hybrid role owns the material and the message they use.

Responsibilities
• Own the proposal library used by the French commercial team
• Rework the pricing narrative so landlords understand the service tiers
• Introduce cross-service positioning between facilities and energy offers
• Run monthly sessions on what is working in live negotiations
• Test new material with two sellers before releasing it widely

Requirements
• Diploma in commerce, marketing or equivalent experience
• Four to five years in sales or sales enablement
• Practical negotiation experience, not only theory about it
• Willingness to challenge material that sellers quietly ignore
• French and English, hybrid in Lyon

Nice to have
• Experience selling into property or facilities management
• Familiarity with collaborative planning boards
• Interest in trying approaches the team has not used before

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
About the role
Osprey Telecom sells connectivity and managed network services to Finnish enterprises. This seat carries a quota against named accounts and works alongside a technical pre-sales colleague on every significant deal.

Responsibilities
• Own a named enterprise account list and its annual quota
• Manage deals through procurement, legal and technical evaluation
• Develop reseller relationships that bring deals you cannot reach alone
• Keep forecasts accurate enough for the network team to plan capacity
• Renegotiate contracts ahead of expiry rather than at it

Requirements
• Diploma in business or equivalent commercial experience
• Four to seven years selling business-to-business services
• Experience carrying and meeting a quota with named accounts
• Discipline managing several deals at different stages at once
• Finnish and English, hybrid in Helsinki

Nice to have
• Exposure to reference data management across commercial systems
• Interest in what improves win rates rather than only activity
• Familiarity with enterprise finance systems buyers use

jobs.title: Territory Sales Representative
jobs.description:
About the role
Ashcombe Packaging supplies food and pharmaceutical packaging to Australian manufacturers. This remote territory seat covers New South Wales and Queensland, selling into procurement teams who buy on total cost rather than unit price.

Responsibilities
• Cover the eastern territory with a mix of visits and video meetings
• Build total-cost proposals that stand up to procurement scrutiny
• Negotiate annual supply agreements with volume commitments
• Train customer teams on handling and specification changes
• Keep the order system reflecting what customers actually agreed

Requirements
• Diploma in business or equivalent commercial experience
• Four to five years of business-to-business territory sales
• Ability to construct an argument that is not about being cheapest
• Comfort with enterprise order systems, including their quirks
• Remote working with two travel weeks each month

Nice to have
• Interest in automating the repetitive parts of quoting
• Adaptability when a customer changes specification mid-agreement
• Packaging, food or pharmaceutical manufacturing experience

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
About the role
Tidewater Shipping's Birmingham commercial office handles inland freight customers whose contracts run for years and whose expectations move constantly. This role owns a small number of large accounts and the relationships inside them.

Responsibilities
• Own six major freight accounts across the Midlands
• Build account plans that name the people, not just the companies
• Set and review service measures jointly with each customer
• Expand into new lanes and services within existing accounts
• Lead quarterly business reviews with customer logistics directors

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in business, logistics or a related field
• Three to five years in key account management
• Experience defining performance measures a customer will sign up to
• Cultural fluency, since several accounts are internationally owned
• Hybrid attendance in Birmingham with customer site visits

Nice to have
• Experience facilitating a difficult review meeting to a good outcome
• Familiarity with issue tracking across a service relationship
• Freight, shipping or supply chain background

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
About the role
Solstice Retail supplies own-brand goods to grocery and convenience chains across France, and this Paris seat opens the doors the field team then walks through. Outbound here means buyers who receive twenty approaches a week.

Responsibilities
• Open conversations with category buyers at national and regional chains
• Research each chain's range gaps before making contact
• Prepare and send tailored sample packs that get opened
• Convert interest into buyer meetings with a clear agenda
• Hit a monthly meeting target agreed with the commercial director

Requirements
• Diploma in commerce or equivalent experience
• Two to six years in outbound, field or inside sales
• Persistence with buyers who are genuinely hard to reach
• Ability to write a proposal that a buyer reads to the end
• French and one other European language, hybrid in Paris

Nice to have
• Grocery or fast-moving consumer goods experience
• Attention to detail in sample presentation, which buyers notice
• Interest in how brand positioning affects listing decisions

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
About the role
Vellum Financial sells payment and reconciliation services to lenders across South East Asia, and this remote Singapore-anchored seat manages the accounts after implementation. Growth here comes from doing the existing relationship well.

Responsibilities
• Manage a portfolio of twenty lender accounts across the region
• Negotiate annual renewals ahead of the contract anniversary
• Identify additional services each lender could genuinely use
• Escalate and track service issues until the customer agrees they are closed
• Forecast portfolio revenue with a stated confidence level

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in business, finance or a related field
• Four to seven years in account management or financial services sales
• Precision with contract terms, because errors here are expensive
• Ability to close an expansion without straining the relationship
• Remote working across South East Asian time zones

Nice to have
• Familiarity with enterprise finance platforms lenders run
• Experience demonstrating a product to a customer's operations team
• Exposure to content systems used for client communication

jobs.title: Retail Sales Associate
jobs.description:
About the role
Palewood Furniture's Cairo showroom serves both walk-in customers and small contract buyers fitting out offices and hotels. This part-time senior floor role covers four days a week and carries the contract enquiries.

Responsibilities
• Serve showroom customers and convert enquiries into specified orders
• Prepare written proposals for small contract fit-out projects
• Introduce complementary pieces and finishes during the specification
• Coordinate delivery scheduling with the warehouse for contract orders
• Keep order paperwork accurate enough for finance to invoice cleanly

Requirements
• Diploma in business, interiors or equivalent retail experience
• Four to five years in retail or contract furniture sales
• Ability to specify a room, not just sell an item from it
• Careful documentation, since contract orders are disputed by paperwork
• Four fixed days weekly, on site in Cairo; Arabic and English

Nice to have
• Contacts among local interior designers and fit-out contractors
• Experience managing your own time across showroom and site visits
• Interest in furniture construction and materials

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
About the role
Northwind Systems sells its scheduling suite to mid-market operators, and the Chicago floor runs a disciplined, high-activity sales motion. This seat carries a quota against a defined vertical and works on site with the team.

Responsibilities
• Own new business quota within the industrial services vertical
• Qualify opportunities hard and disqualify without hesitation
• Run structured discovery calls that surface the real business problem
• Build proposals that map cost of delay to price
• Manage the deal through implementation scoping and pricing sign-off

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent commercial experience
• Two to five years of software or business services sales
• Track record consistently meeting a new business number
• Willingness to adapt approach when the vertical stops responding
• On-site presence in Chicago

Nice to have
• Experience scoping implementation cost into a commercial proposal
• Familiarity with buyer profiling as a targeting tool
• Comfort presenting to a room rather than a screen

jobs.title: Channel Partner Manager
jobs.description:
About the role
Copperfield Estates sells property management software through regional partners across Canada, and this remote seat owns those partners. Your revenue comes through other people's sales teams, which is a different discipline entirely.

Responsibilities
• Recruit and onboard regional partners across Canadian markets
• Negotiate partner agreements including margin and territory terms
• Work joint pipeline with partner sellers rather than around them
• Improve partner conversion by fixing where deals actually stall
• Run quarterly partner reviews against agreed commitments

Requirements
• Diploma in business or equivalent commercial experience
• Two to five years in channel, field or partner-facing sales
• Ability to influence sellers who do not report to you
• Self-motivation, since partner work has no daily rhythm imposed on it
• Remote working with travel across Canadian regions

Nice to have
• Experience supporting a partner through a data migration
• Instinct for widening a partner's product mix
• Collaborative style with internal implementation teams

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
About the role
Osprey Telecom's New York inside sales team covers small and mid-sized business customers at volume. This is a senior seat on that team: higher account values, longer conversations, and responsibility for retention as well as growth.

Responsibilities
• Manage a book of mid-market business connectivity accounts
• Handle renewals in a market where competitors call your customers weekly
• Present service upgrades against measured usage rather than assumption
• Recover accounts that have given notice, where recovery is possible
• Meet a monthly number that does not move when the month is hard

Requirements
• Diploma or equivalent commercial experience
• Four to five years of inside or telephone-based sales
• Proven retention results in a competitive, price-pressured market
• Composure during long days of back-to-back calls
• Remote working with New York hours

Nice to have
• Experience writing your own outreach rather than using templates
• Exposure to campaign tooling used for customer communications
• Awareness of contractual risk in service agreements

jobs.title: Sales Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
About the role
Amberwell Cosmetics sells through retail partners and direct channels, and sales operations keeps both measurable. This remote seat owns the reporting, the forecast process and the automation that removes manual work from both.

Responsibilities
• Own the weekly sales forecast process across retail and direct channels
• Automate the reporting that currently consumes two days each month
• Analyse channel performance and present findings, not just charts
• Maintain the commercial data quality standards the team works to
• Spend one day a month on customer calls to keep context

Requirements
• Diploma in business, analytics or a numerate subject
• Two to seven years in sales operations or commercial analysis
• Practical experience automating a recurring reporting task
• Willingness to tell a commercial director their forecast is wrong
• Remote working with UK hours

Nice to have
• Experience gathering requirements from commercial stakeholders
• Familiarity with document management across a commercial team
• Habit of continually learning new tooling as it arrives

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role
Sable Automotive sells fleet and workshop equipment across the Gulf, and technical credibility decides most of these deals. This Dubai role pairs with account managers to design solutions for workshops and fleet operators.

Responsibilities
• Design equipment solutions for workshop and fleet customers
• Run technical demonstrations at customer sites across the Gulf
• Size installations against workshop throughput and floor space
• Support account managers through technical objections in negotiation
• Maintain the configuration guides the commercial team relies on

Requirements
• Diploma in automotive engineering, business or equivalent experience
• Four to seven years in technical sales or workshop equipment
• Ability to solve a customer's layout problem in front of them
• Willingness to travel across the Gulf region regularly
• Hybrid attendance in Dubai; Arabic an advantage

Nice to have
• Experience influencing a product roadmap from customer feedback
• Comfort producing simple visuals for a proposal
• Awareness of installation budgets and their constraints

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About the role
Ironbark Construction supplies project management software to contractors across India, and this Bangalore role keeps those contractors successful after they buy. Renewal here depends on whether site teams actually use the product.

Responsibilities
• Drive adoption across contractor accounts after implementation
• Run onboarding for site teams who are sceptical of new software
• Track usage and intervene before a renewal becomes a risk
• Grow account value by adding sites and modules where justified
• Report account health honestly to the commercial lead each month

Requirements
• Diploma in business, construction management or equivalent experience
• Three to seven years in customer success or account management
• Ability to win over site staff who prefer paper
• Organised approach to a portfolio at different adoption stages
• Hybrid attendance in Bangalore with site visits

Nice to have
• Construction or engineering project experience
• Exposure to workflow automation inside customer processes
• Experience delivering training to mixed-ability groups

jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.description:
About the role
Talon Security Group is opening a small-business channel in Austin, selling monitored security services directly rather than through resellers. This role builds that channel from a standing start, hybrid with the commercial team.

Responsibilities
• Develop small-business demand for monitored security services
• Close subscription deals with owners who make decisions themselves
• Build the local partner relationships that generate referrals
• Report conversion by lead source so spend follows results
• Work with the operations team on what can be delivered profitably

Requirements
• Diploma in business or equivalent commercial experience
• Four to five years in business development or direct sales
• Track record closing decision-makers without a procurement process
• Team-first approach with a small, closely-working commercial group
• Hybrid attendance in Austin

Nice to have
• Experience segmenting a local market rather than working it broadly
• Familiarity with human resources or workforce systems as a buyer topic
• Exposure to vendor coordination on installation work

jobs.title: Sales Enablement Specialist
jobs.description:
About the role
Duncastle Rail's Cairo office supports commercial teams across Africa and the Middle East. This remote enablement seat equips those teams with the material and training they need to sell rail maintenance services credibly.

Responsibilities
• Build the enablement material for regional rail service propositions
• Train new commercial hires across three countries remotely
• Improve the qualification criteria so weak deals fail earlier
• Support forecast reviews with clean, comparable regional data
• Collect field feedback and act on it rather than filing it

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in business, engineering or a related field
• Three to five years in sales, enablement or commercial support
• Ability to teach across time zones without losing the room
• Composure when several regions demand attention at once
• Arabic, French or English combinations covering the region

Nice to have
• Exposure to how customer requirements are gathered and recorded
• Familiarity with workforce systems used across regional teams
• Interest in rail infrastructure services

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
About the role
Windermere Hotels sells conference and group business across Benelux from its Brussels commercial office. This seat handles the largest corporate and association accounts, and the work is done in person by design.

Responsibilities
• Own the largest corporate and association accounts across Benelux
• Negotiate multi-property agreements with annual volume commitments
• Host site inspections and run them as a genuine sales meeting
• Coordinate with property teams on availability and rate strategy
• Retain accounts through relationship depth rather than discount

Requirements
• Diploma in hospitality, business or equivalent experience
• Two to five years selling to corporate or association buyers
• Experience with multi-site or multi-property commercial agreements
• Presence and polish, since much of this job is hosting
• On-site presence in Brussels; French, Dutch and English

Nice to have
• Existing association or corporate buyer relationships in Benelux
• Familiarity with property systems used at the front desk
• Collaborative approach with property general managers

jobs.title: Territory Sales Representative
jobs.description:
About the role

jobs.title: Key Account Manager

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative

jobs.title: Account Manager

jobs.title: Channel Partner Manager

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative

jobs.title: Sales Engineer

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager

jobs.description:
About the role

jobs.title: Communications Manager

jobs.title: Communications Manager

jobs.title: Credit Controller
jobs.description:
About the role
Cobalt Health Services bills insurers, employers and patients, and each of them pays on a different rhythm. This junior remote role joins the credit team in Berlin, chasing what is owed and learning where the cash actually gets stuck.

Responsibilities
• Chase outstanding balances across insurer, employer and patient ledgers
• Reconcile remittances that arrive without a matching reference
• Prepare the weekly cash collection forecast for the finance manager
• Escalate disputed invoices to the clinic that raised them
• Keep customer contact records accurate and current

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance or business
• Up to three years in a finance or credit role, including placements
• Confident spreadsheet work beyond basic formulas
• Willingness to make the awkward call rather than send another email
• German and English, working remotely with German hours

Nice to have
• Exposure to an enterprise finance system
• Interest in how healthcare billing actually works
• Careful attention to detail on reconciliation work

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Clerk

About the role

• Process supplier invoices across four European operating companies
• Match invoices to purchase orders and resolve the mismatches
• Prepare payment runs for review by the payables supervisor
• Support the month-end accruals process with supporting schedules
• Respond to supplier queries within the agreed service standard

Requirements
• Bachelor's degree in accounting, commerce or finance
• Up to three years in a payables or general finance role

• Remote working with European hours overlap

Nice to have
• Exposure to bank reconciliation work
• Interest in progressing toward a management accounting role
• Familiarity with service desk tooling for supplier queries

jobs.title: Internal Auditor

Nice to have

• Interest in pursuing a professional accounting qualification
• Familiarity with documentation tooling used across the business
